title: UPSC CAPF AC 2025 Final Marks
postName: Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination 2025
vacancyDetails: Final result of CAPF (AC) / CPF Assistant Commandants Examination 2025 for BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB and related forces
qualification: Bachelor’s degree from a recognized university as per CAPF (AC) notification
ageLimit: 20 to 25 years as on relevant date (relaxations as per UPSC CAPF rules)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Physical Standards / Physical Efficiency Tests → Medical Standards Tests → Interview / Personality Test → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Roll number; educational certificates, category certificate, identity proof for PST/PET and interview stages
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsc.gov.in
2. Open Examination → Final Results
3. Download CAPF (AC) / CPF AC 2025 Final Result PDF
4. Search your roll number in the recommended list
5. Follow force allocation / further instructions from MHA / UPSC
shortDescription: UPSC CPF / CAPF Assistant Commandants 2025 Final Result is out. Download PDF from upsc.gov.in.
content:
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the Final Result of the Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination 2025 (also referred as UPSC CPF AC).

The PDF contains roll numbers of candidates recommended for appointment as Assistant Commandants in CAPFs based on written exam, PET/PST, medical standards and interview / personality test.

Forces covered (typical)

  • Border Security Force (BSF)
  • Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)
  • Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)
  • Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)
  • Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)

Candidates should download the official list only from upsc.gov.in and await joining / force allocation communications from the Ministry of Home Affairs as applicable.
